name: Holiday tree
about: A pointy spruce tree with colourful baubles, a yellow star and presents underneath.

layers.name: Trunk and presents
layers.tip: A spruce log in the middle. Wool blocks around it are the presents.

layers.name: Bottom branches
layers.tip: A log on the trunk, and spruce leaves around it in a big diamond. Some red and blue wool are baubles. Collect leaves with shears.

layers.name: Middle branches
layers.tip: A smaller diamond of leaves around the trunk.

layers.name: More branches
layers.tip: The same size again, with baubles in new places.

layers.name: Top branches
layers.tip: A small plus of leaves around the trunk.

layers.name: Point
layers.tip: A single leaf on top of the trunk.

layers.name: Star
layers.tip: Yellow wool on the very top is the star.
